<p class="page-kind page-kind-manual">Manual</p>

Every manual page, grouped by stage of a post-processing project. Step-by-step
worked examples are in the [Tutorials](tutorial-00-first-analysis.html), and the
full argument reference for every function is in the
[function reference](../reference/index.html).

## Getting started

- **[Installation](manual-00-installation.html)** — install `mrmhub` and load it.
- **[Key Concepts & Glossary](manual-01-key-concepts.html)** — the data model, core terminology, and where QUANT fits in the MRMhub workflow.

## Preparing and running

- **[Importing Analytical Data](manual-04-data-import.html)** — choosing an importer and the file layout each one expects.
- **[Importing Metadata](manual-05-metadata.html)** — attaching sample, feature, and internal-standard annotations.
- **[Drift and Batch Correction](manual-07-corrections.html)** — correcting signal drift within runs and offsets between batches.
- **[Quarto Workflows](manual-11-quarto-workflows.html)** — recording a pipeline as a `.qmd` notebook, coloured console output, and rendering to HTML, PDF, and Word.

## Results and downstream use

- **[Visualisation Functions](manual-08-visualization.html)** — RunScatter, PCA, run-sequence, and normalization-QC plots.
- **[Writing Pipelines with AI Assistants](manual-09-ai-assistants.html)** — grounding LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, local models) in the real API, and verifying what they produce.

## Reference

- **[The MRMhubExperiment Data Object](manual-02-data-object.html)** — the tables, identifiers, and feature variables of the central object.
- **[Design Decisions](manual-03-design-decisions.html)** — why the package is built the way it is.
- **[Sample Types & QC Roles](manual-06-sample-types.html)** — every sample-type (`qc_type`) label and its role in QC.
- **[Troubleshooting & FAQ](manual-10-troubleshooting.html)** — frequent problems and how to resolve them.

## See also

- [Tutorials](tutorial-00-first-analysis.html) — worked, end-to-end examples
- [Function reference](../reference/index.html) — full arguments for every function
- [INTEGRATOR documentation](https://slinghub.github.io/MRMhub/integrator/) — upstream peak integration
